purpose: Preserve user-supplied historical Titan AIEngine architecture and inform resilient asynchronous JANUS microkernel design.

component_lineage.name: Nexus
component_lineage.observed: separates persistent services from occasional modules and quarantines unhealthy modules
component_lineage.new_rule: supervisor, supervised independent workers, bounded retries, no process-level dynamic code import

component_lineage.name: JanusHippocampus
component_lineage.observed: SQLite WAL memory plus graph and evolution journals
component_lineage.new_rule: transactional append-only receipts and provenance-linked shared knowledge

component_lineage.name: Hypnos
component_lineage.observed: async retries with increasing backoff and assimilation
component_lineage.new_rule: bounded exponential backoff plus circuit breaker and idempotency

component_lineage.name: Chronos
component_lineage.new_rule: read-only context requests with timestamp lineage

component_lineage.name: Ouroboros
component_lineage.observed: model-generated new modules and core proposals
component_lineage.new_rule: candidate-only source, isolated testing, independent evaluation, review, canary and rollback

component_lineage.name: Trinity
component_lineage.new_rule: parallel peers with timeouts, per-peer provenance and independent verifier

component_lineage.name: JanusNerve
component_lineage.observed: UDP nerve endpoint and log observation
component_lineage.new_rule: least-privilege event ingestion, no externally exposed listener by default

component_lineage.name: AIEngine
component_lineage.observed: continuous async ticker, entropy/health and services
component_lineage.new_rule: fixed bounded cycles, persisted task IDs, fairness, backpressure, no runaway recursion

legacy_security_findings: importlib.util.spec.loader.exec_module runs downloaded local modules in core process, so it is not a sandbox
fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task on services has no full restart/health supervision
probabilistic plugin selection can starve eligible work
autoregenerated modules were written to a modules folder without independent tests
wide UDP binding or exception swallowing is not independent safety evidence

implementations.result: 2 passes over 48 public repositories; independent fault isolation; gate HOLD
Rules bound to model prompt with digest; separate isolated evaluation remains

gate_reason: Independent G1-G20 acceptance, external authenticated ACK, true cross-organ consumption and unrestricted code-module self-extension are not yet established by these observations.
